title: The Illusion of Validity
coreMove: downgrade confidence when the task gives coherent impressions but weak predictive feedback
sourcePressure: shows that strong confidence in judgment can survive even when predictive validity is weak
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: treating confidence as arrogance only instead of a feeling produced by coherence

hook: opening with a named bias definition for The Illusion of Validity
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
